update.name: patterns-base-fips
update.description:
This pattern installs the FIPS 140-3 specific packages that are required if you want to run the machine with "fips=1".
Please note that this pattern only enables FIPS 140-3 compliant operation, it does not directly make the system FIPS 140-3 certified nor validated.
Please refer to SUSE official statements on the state of FIPS 140-3 certification.

update.name: patterns-base-minimal_base
update.description: This is the minimal runtime system. It is really a minimal system. It is intended as base for Appliances.
